data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be int64 values identifying validation rows in canonical validation order, equal to np.arange(number_of_validation_rows). scores must be a finite one-dimensional float array of identical length, containing only the shared model's long_view logits in that same canonical order. No labels, is_click targets, auxiliary probabilities, or other arrays may be written.

model_input.description: model.py receives encoded feature rows with shape (N, 2), where column 0 is the offset user index and column 1 is the offset video index, plus the scalar encoded vocabulary dimension. It must preserve the existing additive user/video effects and 16-dimensional interaction pathway, extend them with a shared representation and an impression-level binary is_click auxiliary head, and train on total_loss = long_view_BCE + 0.2 * is_click_BCE. The public predict(features) method must return only long_view logits as a finite float vector of length N; auxiliary click predictions are training-only and must not alter the prediction file.
